# Command-Line Help for `message-reexporter`

This document contains the help content for the `message-reexporter` command-line program.

**Command Overview:**

* [`message-reexporter`↴](#message-reexporter)

## `message-reexporter`

Convert an existing Message Vault output to another format

**Usage:** `message-reexporter [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT> --output <OUTPUT>`

###### **Options:**

* `--input <INPUT>` — Directory containing a prior Message Vault output (auto-detected)
* `--output <OUTPUT>` — Output directory for the converted export
* `--format <FORMAT>` — Output format: `json` (default), `jsonl`, `csv`, `eml`, `mbox`, or `xml`

  Default value: `json`
* `--obfuscate` — Rewrite output with stable fake names/numbers/text and placeholder media
* `--obfuscate-seed <OBFUSCATE_SEED>` — Optional 8-hex seed for reproducible obfuscation (implies --obfuscate)
* `--media-mode <MODE>` — Attachment media: disabled, clone (default), convert, or compress

  Default value: `clone`
* `--media-max-resolution <RES>` — Compress only: max long edge (720p, 1080p, 4k)

  Default value: `1080p`
* `--media-max-fps <MEDIA_MAX_FPS>` — Compress only: max frame rate

  Default value: `30`
* `--media-min-size <MEDIA_MIN_SIZE>` — Compress only: only re-encode videos at/above this size (e.g. 20M)

  Default value: `20M`
* `--media-skip-efficient <MEDIA_SKIP_EFFICIENT>` — Compress only: skip already-efficient HEVC under max resolution (default on)

  Default value: `true`

  Possible values: `true`, `false`
